sections.title: 1. Overview & Commitment
sections.content: This Privacy Policy describes how the Houbungla & Ladeilhen application ("we," "us," or "our"), published by the Literature and Publication Board of the Kuki Baptist Convention (India), handles your information. Your privacy is of paramount importance to us. We are committed to protecting your personal information and providing a safe, transparent, and private worship experience. This policy explains what data we process and how your information is handled.

sections.title: 2. Information We Do Not Collect
sections.content:
The Houbungla & Ladeilhen app is built as a private, offline-first Christian worship companion. We do not collect, harvest, track, sell, or share any personal information. Specifically, we do NOT collect:
• Your physical location, GPS, or IP-based geolocation data.
• Your device hardware identifiers (IMEI, MAC address, advertising ID).
• Your contacts, phone book, SMS, photos, media, or private file directories.
• Usage analytics, browsing activity, or behavioral tracking telemetry.

sections.title: 3. Google Authentication & Cloud Sync
sections.content:
If you voluntarily choose to sign in with your Google Account, we use Google Firebase Authentication solely to identify your account and enable optional cloud synchronization. When signed in:
• Only your user identifier, display name, and email address provided by Google are used to create your secure sync session.
• Your personal bookmarks (Favourites) and custom song lists (Custom Lists) are stored securely in Google Cloud Firestore under strict security rules so that only you can access, edit, or delete them.
• You can sign out at any time or use the entire application completely offline without signing in.

sections.title: 4. Direct In-App Feedback & Suggestions
sections.content: When you voluntarily submit feedback, typos, or suggestions through the in-app feedback dialog, your message, subject, optional contact email, and referenced hymn details are saved securely to our Cloud Firestore database solely for review by the Literature and Publication Board to make corrections and improve the hymnal.

sections.title: 5. Local Device Storage
sections.content: Personalization features such as Reading History, Favourites, Custom Lists, and display preferences (font size, reading theme, keep-screen-awake setting) are stored directly on your device using local SQLite and SharedPreferences. This data stays on your device and is never shared with third parties.

sections.title: 6. Network Requests & Content Updates
sections.content:
The app makes anonymous network requests for the following purposes:
• Hymn Database & Content Updates: Periodically checking and downloading updated hymn collections and lyrics corrections from our official server (https://kbclit.github.io/hbla/hymns/).
• In-App Updates: Checking Google Play Store availability for new application builds.
• Privacy Policy Updates: Fetching updated policy revisions.

These network requests are anonymous and do not transmit any personal data or device identifiers.

sections.title: 7. Permissions Requested & Justifications
sections.content:
The application requests minimal Android system permissions strictly necessary for worship utility:
• WAKE_LOCK (Keep Screen On): Allows uninterrupted viewing of lyrics and songs without screen dimming.
• VIBRATE (Haptic Feedback): Provides subtle tactile feedback when navigating songs and tapping interactive controls.
• INTERNET & ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE: Allows checking for hymn database updates, submitting user feedback, and synchronizing cloud bookmarks when connected to the internet.

sections.title: 8. Children's Privacy
sections.content: The Houbungla & Ladeilhen app is designed for all audiences, including families and children. We do not knowingly collect, solicit, or maintain any personal information from children under the age of 13.

sections.title: 9. Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.content: We may update our Privacy Policy periodically to reflect new features or regulatory requirements. Any updates will be published within the app and on our official portal. You can review the active version at any time in the app's About & Privacy Policy section.

sections.title: 10. Contact Information & Grievances
sections.content:
If you have questions, feedback, or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact us:
